facts.fact: The notice states the Data Protection Act, 2022 designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, which issues this directive; the notice is undated and 2024 is taken from its number.

General Notice No. 4/2024 directs all data controllers to appoint Data Protection Officers by 30 May 2024 under section 48(1) of the Act, per General Notice No. 7/2023; the document is undated and uses the published date 2024-01-01 as a proxy.
The authority issued a general directive requiring every data controller to appoint a Data Protection Officer and notify it by 30 May 2024; no decision on a named controller or count is given.
